blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language verifiers judge whether an image faithfully matches a textual description, yet existing training pipelines typically rely on static supervision from stronger external judges or curated hard-negative data. Such supervision requires external generation or annotation, is teacher-bounded, and is difficult to adapt as model failures evolve. We introduce PROVE (Perturb-and-Repair Optimization for Vision-Language Evaluation), a self-play framework that trains verifiers through a closed perturb-verify-repair-verify loop. Starting from a known-correct image-caption pair, a Mutator introduces a typed perturbation over objects, attributes, counts, or relations. The verifier then judges the perturbed caption and provides textual feedback, which a Repairer uses to recover a faithful caption for re-verification. These two verification rounds produce structured rewards for informative mismatches and visually grounded repairs. Since perturbation, verification, and repair are role-conditioned behaviors of the same evolving multimodal backbone, updating the shared parameters also improves the verifier itself. Experiments show that PROVE improves fine-grained compositional verification across model scales and families and strengthens visual-detail robustness on the reference backbone, with limited, benchmark-dependent changes on broader multimodal tasks.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言核查者判断一个图像是否忠实地与文字描述相符,但现有的培训管道通常依靠更强大的外部法官的静态监督或整理硬阴性数据。 这种监督需要外部生成或注释,由教师负责,而且难以随着模型故障的演变而适应。 我们引入了PROVE(Perturb-and-Repair Optimization for Vision-Language Experience),这是一种通过闭塞式扰动-验证-修复-验证循环对验证员进行培训的自演框架. 从已知的正确图像封装对开始,突变器在对象,属性,计数或关系上引入打字扰动. 核查人然后判断扰动的字幕并提供文字反馈,修理人用这些文字反馈来回收一个忠实的字幕进行重新核查. 这两轮核查对信息不匹配和视网膜修理产生结构性奖励。 由于扰动、核查和修理是同一演变中的多式联运主干线的角色条件行为,更新共享参数也改进了核查者本身。 实验表明,PROVE改进了跨模型尺度和家庭的精细成份核查,并加强了参考主干线上的视觉-细节强健性,对更广泛的多式联运任务进行了有限、依赖基准的改变。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision-language models have made rapid progress in image-text understanding, yet they still often miss subtle but consequential mismatches between an image and a textual description. A caption may differ from the image by a substituted object, a misbound attribute, an incorrect count, or a reversed relation, while still retaining high global semantic similarity. As illustrated in Fig. 1 1(a) , these errors lie along fine-grained visual-semantic axes that are difficult to capture with coarse image-text scores. This limitation is especially important because VLMs are increasingly used as verifiers : given an image and a description, the verifier judges whether the description faithfully matches the image. Such verifiers support VLM-as-judge evaluation [ 49 ] , reward modeling for RLHF [ 29 ] and RLAIF [ 16 ] , generated-image filtering, and hallucination detection [ 19 , 9 ] . A central question is therefore how to train verifiers that recognize localized image-text misalignment, rather than merely score global semantic compatibility.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型在图像文本理解方面取得了快速进展,然而它们仍然经常错过图像与文字描述之间微妙但随之而来的不匹配. 标题可能因替换对象、错误绑定属性、不正确计数或倒置关系而与图像不同,同时仍然保留高全球语义相似性。 如图11(a)所示,这些错误是沿着难以用粗糙的图像文字分数捕捉的精细视觉语义轴发生的。 这一限制特别重要,因为VLMs越来越多地被用作验证器:给一个图像和描述,验证器判断描述是否忠实地与图像匹配. 这些核查员支持VLM-as-judge评价[49],奖励RLHF[29]和RLAIF[16]的模型,生成图像过滤,以及幻觉检测[19,9]. 因此,一个核心问题是,如何培训确认局部图像文本错配的核查员,而不是仅仅评分全球语义兼容性。

blocks.en: The dominant recipe imports supervision from outside the target model, as summarized in Fig. 1 1(b) . A stronger reference judge, typically a larger VLM or a curated process reward model, scores candidate image-text pairs, and the target verifier is trained to imitate or optimize against that score [ 46 , 39 , 20 ] . Alternatively, training relies on human-labeled or synthetically generated hard negatives [ 17 , 30 , 14 ] . Although effective, both routes provide static supervision. The student is bounded by the perceptual distinctions exposed by the external judge or negative set; the supervision may lag behind evolving model failures; and extending verification to new axes such as counting, relations, or attribute binding often requires new annotation or generation pipelines. The core challenge is to obtain image-text mismatches that are simultaneously grounded in the image, hard enough to train fine-grained discrimination, and gradable without relying on a stronger external judge.
blocks.zh: 如图1 1(b)所示,主要食谱进口监督从目标模式之外进行。 更强的参考裁判,一般是更大的VLM或曲解的流程奖励模型,给候选人的图像文本配对评分,目标核查员经过训练可以模仿或优化该评分[46,39,20]. 另一种办法是,培训依靠人类标签或合成产生的硬底片[17、30、14]。 虽然有效,但两条路线都提供静态监督. 学生受外部裁判员暴露的知觉区分或负集的束缚;监督可能落后于不断演变的模型故障;将核查扩展到新的轴,如计数,关系,或属性约束,往往需要新的注释或生成管道. 核心挑战在于获得图像文本的错配,这些错配同时基于图像,硬度足以训练精细的歧视,且可以不依赖更强大的外部法官进行分级.

blocks.en: We introduce PROVE ( P erturb-and- R epair O ptimization for V ision-Language E valuation), a self-play framework that trains a verifier through a closed perturb–verify–repair–verify loop (Fig. 1 1(c) ). Starting from a known-correct image-caption pair, a Mutator creates a minimally perturbed caption by editing one visual-semantic axis, such as object identity, attribute, count, or relation. The verifier then judges the perturbed caption and provides feedback about the mismatch. Conditioned on this feedback, a Repairer attempts to recover a faithful caption, which is verified again. Crucially, perturbation, verification, and repair are not separate models: they are three role-conditioned behaviors of the same evolving VLM. The two verification rounds produce rewards for informative perturbations and visually grounded repairs, while shared-parameter updates also improve the verifier used at evaluation time.

blocks.en: This formulation is well matched to fine-grained image-text verification. The Mutator does not generate arbitrary text corruptions; it creates controlled, localized mismatches whose semantic axes mirror common compositional failures. The verifier must diagnose the mismatch before repair and recognize the corrected caption after repair, while the Repairer must localize the error and infer the visually faithful description. In this way, PROVE converts ordinary clean image-caption pairs into adaptive hard negatives and repair targets. Compared with external-judge distillation, the training signal is not bounded by a stronger frozen oracle. Compared with fixed hard-negative training, the mismatch distribution evolves with the current verifier.
blocks.zh: 这种配方与精细的图像文本验证非常吻合. 突变器不会产生任意的文字腐败;它会产生受控,局部的不匹配,其语义轴会镜像常见的构成故障. 校验者在修复前必须诊断不匹配,并在修复后识别校正的字幕,而校验者必须确定错误的位置,并推断视觉上的忠实描述. 这样,PROVE将普通的清洁图像封装对转换成适应性硬底片和修复目标. 与外部裁判的蒸馏相比,训练信号没有被更强的冷冻甲骨板所束缚. 与固定的硬阴性训练相比,不匹配的分布随目前的验证器而演变.

blocks.en: We evaluate PROVE on a Qwen3.5-2B backbone across fine-grained compositional alignment benchmarks and broader vision-language robustness benchmarks. PROVE consistently improves the same backbone on compositional verification, with the largest gains appearing on axes aligned with the perturbation space, such as attribute and relation understanding. It also improves visual-detail sensitivity and maintains hallucination robustness, while broader capability changes are limited and benchmark-dependent. Training diagnostics further show that perturbation and repair co-adapt through verifier feedback. These results suggest that vision-language verifiers can be strengthened through verifier-guided self-play rather than static judge distillation.
blocks.zh: 我们通过精细的组合调整基准和更广泛的愿景语言稳健性基准,对Wen3.5-2B主干网进行评估。 PROVE在组成核查方面不断改进同样的支柱,最大收益出现在与扰动空间一致的轴上,如属性和关系理解. 它还提高了视觉-细节敏感性,保持了幻觉稳健性,而更广泛的能力变化是有限的,并依赖于基准. 培训诊断进一步表明,通过核查者的反馈,扰动和修复共同适应。 这些结果表明,通过核查者制导的自我游戏,而不是静态判断蒸馏,可以加强视觉语言验证器.

blocks.en: Matched supervision baselines, independent verifier audits, and additional Qwen3.5-4B and InternVL3-2B experiments further support this teacher-free adaptive alternative. The present study establishes caption-based verification and benchmark transfer; task-specific self-play for VQA, grounding, and referring expressions remains future work.
blocks.zh: 匹配的监督基线、独立核查人审计以及额外的Quen3.5-4B和InternVL3-2B实验进一步支持这种无教师适应性替代方案。 本研究报告确定了基于标题的核查和基准转让;针对特定任务的VQA自我游戏、定位和参考表达仍然是今后的工作。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Vision-language verifiers for image-text understanding. Evaluating whether an image faithfully matches a textual description is a central problem in vision-language understanding. Coarse image-text similarity metrics are often insufficient, because they can miss fine-grained errors in object identity, attribute binding, counting, and spatial relations. Recent work therefore uses vision-language models as verifiers or judges for multimodal evaluation, reward modeling, generated-image filtering, and hallucination detection [ 49 , 19 , 9 , 8 ] . These verifiers are attractive because they can provide semantic judgments beyond fixed embedding similarities, but their reliability depends on whether they can detect subtle image-text mismatches. PROVE targets this capability directly by training the verifier through controlled perturbation, verification, and repair over the same compositional axes that commonly challenge image-text understanding.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言验证器,用于图像文本理解. 评价一个图像是否忠实地匹配文字描述,是视觉语言理解中的一个核心问题. 粗糙的图像文本相似度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度 因此,最近的工作利用视觉语言模型作为验证人或评断人进行多式联运评价、奖励模型、生成图像过滤和幻觉检测[49、19、9、8]。 这些验证器具有吸引力,因为它们能提供超出固定嵌入相似度的语义判断,但其可靠性取决于它们能否检测到微妙的图像-文本不匹配. PROVE直接针对这种能力,方法是通过控制性扰动、核查和修复通常挑战图像文本理解的同一组成轴对核查者进行培训。

blocks.en: Training verifiers with static external supervision. A common way to train multimodal verifiers is to import supervision from outside the target model. For example, stronger VLMs or curated reward models can score candidate image-text pairs, after which the target model is optimized by preference learning or reward-based training [ 46 , 39 , 18 , 20 , 38 , 37 ] . Another line constructs fixed hard-negative datasets or synthetic preference pairs, then trains the verifier to distinguish faithful captions from controlled corruptions [ 21 ] . These approaches provide useful supervision, but the signal is static: it is bounded by the external judge, fixed negative generator, or annotation pipeline. As models and evaluation distributions evolve, their failure modes may shift away from this supervision. In contrast, PROVE does not distill a stronger frozen judge or rely on a fixed hard-negative set. It uses the current verifier itself inside a perturb–verify–repair–verify loop, so the training signal changes with the evolving model.
blocks.zh: 具有静态外部监督的培训核查员。 培训多式联运核查员的一个共同办法是从目标模式之外进口监督。 例如,更强的VLM或曲解的奖励模型可以给候选的图像文本对分,之后通过偏好学习或基于奖励的培训优化目标模型[46,39,18,20,38,37]. 另一行构造固定的硬阴性数据集或合成偏好对,然后训练核查员区分忠实标题和受控腐败[21]. 这些方法提供了有用的监督,但信号是静态的:它由外部判断器,固定的负发生器,或者注音管道所约束. 随着模型和评价分布的演变,其失败模式可能会偏离这种监督. 相比之下,PROVE不蒸馏更强的冷冻判官或依赖固定的硬阴性成套. 它使用当前验证器本身在一个扰动-验证-修复-验证循环中,因此训练信号随演化模型而变化.

blocks.en: Self-play and self-evolving multimodal learning. Self-play has been widely used to improve agents and reasoning systems, from game-playing methods such as AlphaZero [ 36 ] to debate and recent self-evolving LLMs [ 13 , 12 , 47 ] . More recent asymmetric self-play methods train one behavior to propose tasks and another to solve them, creating an adaptive curriculum without a fixed external teacher [ 23 ] . In multimodal learning, self-evolving VLMs have also been explored through questioner–reasoner interactions and pseudo-labeling from model samples [ 10 ] . However, consensus- or uncertainty-based supervision can still reinforce confident mistakes, especially when the model fails to perceive the relevant visual evidence. PROVE differs in both task and interaction structure: it trains a vision-language verifier rather than a general reasoner, and it grounds self-play in clean image-caption pairs. The Mutator creates typed image-text mismatches, the verifier diagnoses them, and the Repairer attempts to correct them; all three are role-conditioned behaviors of the same evolving MLLM.
blocks.zh: 自玩与自演多模式学习. 自玩被广泛用于改进代理和推理系统,从AlphaZero[36]等游戏玩法到辩论和最近的自演LLMS[13,12,47]. 更近代的不对称自玩方法训练一种行为来提出任务,另一种行为来解决这些问题,创建一个没有固定的外部老师的适应性课程[23]. 在多模式学习中,也通过质疑者-理性者互动和模型样本中的伪标签来探索自演VLM[10]. 然而,基于共识或不确定性的监督仍然可能强化信心错误,特别是在模型无法看到相关视觉证据时。 PROVE在任务和交互结构上都有所不同:它训练一种视觉语言的验证器而不是一般的推理器,它将自我扮演定位为干净的图像封装对. 突变器创建了打字的图像文本不匹配,验证器诊断这些不匹配,修复器试图纠正这些不匹配;这三种都是相同演化的MLLM的角色条件行为.

blocks.en: Compositional image-text alignment. Vision-language models often struggle with compositional understanding despite strong global image-text alignment. Benchmarks such as Winoground [ 40 ] , ARO [ 44 ] , SugarCrepe [ 11 ] , and VL-CheckList [ 48 ] test whether models can distinguish captions that differ in objects, attributes, relations, or word order. Prior methods improve this ability with hard-negative contrastive learning or synthetic data [ 44 , 7 ] . PROVE is complementary: it generates controlled perturbations online and uses verifier-guided repair to create adaptive supervision for fine-grained image-text alignment.
blocks.zh: 组成图像文本对齐. 尽管全球图像文本高度一致,但视觉语言模式往往难以理解构成。 诸如Winoground [40],ARO [44],SugarCrepe [11],以及VL-CheckList [48]等基准测试模型是否能够区分对象,属性,关系,或词序等不同的标题. 先前的方法通过硬负式对比性学习或合成数据提高这种能力[44,7]. PROVE是互补的:它在网上产生可控扰动,并使用核查器-制导修复,为精细的图像-文本对齐建立适应性监督.

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview

blocks.en:
PROVE trains a vision-language verifier through a closed perturb–verify–repair–verify loop.
Given a clean image-caption pair, a single multimodal policy π θ \pi_{\theta} is reused under three role prompts: a Mutator that perturbs the caption, a Verifier that judges image-caption faithfulness, and a Repairer that corrects the caption using verifier feedback.
These roles are not separate models; they are three behaviors of the same parameter-shared backbone.
Thus, every policy update also changes the verifier used at evaluation time.
Figure 2 illustrates the overall loop.

blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Backbone and training framework. We instantiate PROVE with Qwen3.5-2B [ 31 ] as the shared multimodal backbone.
The same parameters are reused across the Mutator, Verifier, and Repairer roles, with role identity specified only by the prompt template.
Thus, perturbation, verification, and repair are optimized as role-conditioned behaviors of one evolving MLLM rather than as separate models.
At evaluation time, we use the Verifier role of the evolved shared model to judge image-caption faithfulness.
blocks.zh:
后骨和训练框架。 我们以Quen3.5-2B[31]作为共同的多式联运骨干,即时开发。
同样的参数在Mutator,Vivier,和修补器角色之间被重新使用,角色身份仅由即时模板指定.
因此,扰动、核查和修理被优化为一个不断发展的MLLM的角色条件行为,而不是单独的模型。
在评估时,我们利用进化的共享模型的验证器角色来判断图像封装的忠诚度.

blocks.en:
Training data and self-play construction. We train on a 48k-example subset of ShareGPT-4o-Image-style image-caption pairs [ 4 ] , with a held-out validation split of 5k examples.
Each self-play episode starts from a known-correct image-caption pair.
The Mutator introduces a typed perturbation along one of four visual-semantic axes: object, attribute, count, or relation.
The Verifier then judges the perturbed caption and produces a decision-feedback pair.
Conditioned on this feedback, the Repairer generates a repaired caption, which is judged again by the same Verifier role.
The two verification rounds provide verifier-guided rewards for self-play optimization.
No stronger external judge, human-labeled hard negatives, or additional hard-negative annotations are used during training.
blocks.zh:
培训数据与自演建设. 我们用一个48k-例子集的 ShareGPT-4o-Image 风格的图像封装对 [4] , 被搁置的验证拆分5k例.
每个自演剧集都从已知的正确图像封装对开始.
突变器沿四个视觉语义轴中的一个引入了打字扰动:对象,属性,计数,或关系.
验证员然后判断扰动的字幕,并产生一对裁决反馈。
以这种反馈为条件,修补者会生成一个修补的字幕,由同一验证器角色再次判断.
两轮核查为自我游戏优化提供核查指导奖励.
在训练期间没有使用更强大的外部裁判,人标硬底片,或附加硬底片说明.

blocks.en:
Optimization and compute. We implement PROVE using the VeRL/HybridFlow training framework [ 35 ] and optimize the shared policy with DrGRPO [ 27 ] , a group-relative policy optimization variant that removes the standard-deviation normalization used in vanilla GRPO [ 34 ] .
Unless otherwise specified, we use rollout size n = 3 n=3 , learning rate 5 × 10 − 7 5\times 10^{-7} , global batch size 48, KL coefficient 0.005 0.005 , and PPO clip range [ 0.20 , 0.22 ] [0.20,0.22] .
All main training runs are conducted on a single node with 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs using BF16 mixed precision.
We report the best validation checkpoint in the main results.
Training hyperparameters, role interfaces, and additional experimental results are provided in the appendix.
The reference run takes 11 hours on 8 A100 GPUs (88 GPU-hours); Appendix A.4 compares complete pipeline costs.
We will release the training and evaluation code to facilitate reproducibility.

所有主要训练运行在一个单一节点上进行,使用BF16混合精度的8个NVIDIA A100 GPU.

Evaluation protocol. Our main evaluation focuses on fine-grained image-text understanding, where a verifier must distinguish captions that differ by localized semantic changes.
Table 1 compares PROVE with representative compositional understanding methods on four benchmarks shared with [ 30 ] : ARO [ 44 ] , VL-CheckList [ 48 ] , ColorSwap [ 3 ] , and FG-OVD [ 1 ] .
These benchmarks cover relation and attribute reasoning, object-level grounding, color-word order sensitivity, and fine-grained open-vocabulary recognition.
For each baseline, we report the values published in the original paper whenever available; when a benchmark was not reported but public code is available, we use our reproduction under the same evaluation protocol.

blocks.en:
Compositional understanding. Table 1 compares PROVE with representative compositional understanding methods on ARO, VL-CheckList, ColorSwap, and FG-OVD.
Because these methods differ in backbone architecture, training data, objectives, and benchmark coverage, the cross-method comparison should be interpreted as a contextual reference rather than a fully controlled comparison.
Our main controlled comparison is between Qwen3.5-2B and PROVE using the same backbone.
Under this controlled setting, PROVE improves the overall average from 83.22 to 86.85, with consistent gains across all four benchmark groups.
The largest improvement appears on ARO, where the average score increases by + 7.25 +7.25 , indicating stronger attribute and relation discrimination. PROVE also improves VL-CheckList, ColorSwap, and FG-OVD, suggesting that the learned verifier benefits not only the perturbation axes seen during self-play but also broader forms of localized image-text grounding.
Compared with prior compositional methods, PROVE achieves the best overall average among complete rows in this table and remains competitive on individual benchmark groups, despite using a compact shared backbone and no external hard-negative dataset.
These results support the core design of PROVE .
The Mutator creates controlled mismatches over objects, attributes, counts, and relations; the Verifier learns to diagnose these mismatches; and the Repairer learns to recover visually faithful captions.
The resulting self-play signal strengthens fine-grained image-text verification without relying on a stronger external judge.
blocks.zh:
组成理解. 表1将PROVE与关于ARO、VL-CheckList、ColorSwap和FG-OVD的代表性组成理解方法进行比较。
由于这些方法在骨干结构、培训数据、目标和基准覆盖面方面各不相同,跨方法比较应被解释为一种背景参考,而不是一种完全有控制的比较。
我们的主要控制比较是使用同一主干线的Quen3.5-2B和PROVE.
在这种控制下,PROVE将总体平均数从83.22提高到86.85,这四个基准组都取得了一致的收益。
最大的改进出现在ARO上,平均得分增加了+7.25+7.25,表明属性和关系歧视更强. PROVE还改进了VL-CheckList,ColorSwap,以及FG-OVD,建议所学的校验器不仅有利于自玩过程中看到的扰动轴,而且有利于更广泛的局部图像文本定位形式.
与先前的构成方法相比,PROVE在本表中的完整行中实现了最佳的总体平均值,并在单个基准组上保持竞争力,尽管使用了紧凑的共享主干线,没有外部硬负数据集.
这些结果支持了PROVE的核心设计.
变异器在对象,属性,计数和关系上产生可控的不匹配;验证器学习诊断这些不匹配;修补器学习恢复视觉忠实的字幕.
由此产生的自玩信号加强了精细的图像文本验证,而无需依赖更强大的外部判断.

blocks.en:
Broader vision-language understanding benchmarks. Table 2 evaluates whether the learned verifier transfers beyond the main compositional suites. PROVE improves the Qwen3.5-2B backbone on all three benchmarks, raising the average from 58.77 to 61.03.
The most notable gain is on MMVP, where pair accuracy improves by + 4.00 +4.00 , suggesting improved sensitivity to fine visual details.
Winoground also improves, indicating better role binding under hard image-text contrasts, while MMBench-EN shows a modest positive change, suggesting positive transfer to this general multimodal perception and reasoning benchmark.

Limitations. PROVE uses four types of localized caption perturbations, which align with the evaluated compositional axes and may saturate as the Repairer improves.
Although independent audits support improved visual correctness, an evolving shared Verifier can still reinforce its own perceptual mistakes.
Training depends on faithful starting captions from one corpus and requires four role-conditioned calls per trajectory, increasing compute relative to static supervision.
Broader capability changes are benchmark-dependent, including regressions on ViVerBench, MMMU, and MathVista.
Task-specific self-play for VQA, grounding, and referring expressions remains untested.
Imperfect verifiers can also propagate errors when used for automated evaluation or filtering; these uses require independent validation.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced PROVE , a self-play framework for training vision-language verifiers through a closed perturb–verify–repair–verify loop.
Instead of relying on stronger external judges, fixed hard-negative datasets, or static preference annotations, PROVE converts ordinary clean image-caption pairs into adaptive verification episodes.
A single shared MLLM acts as a Mutator, Verifier, and Repairer under different role prompts: the Mutator creates localized image-text mismatches, the Verifier diagnoses them, and the Repairer attempts to recover faithful captions from visual evidence and verifier feedback.
This design turns verification into an operational self-improvement problem, where the model learns not only to judge image-text faithfulness but also to expose and correct its own fine-grained failure modes.
The resulting training signal is grounded, adaptive, and verifier-guided.
Typed perturbations over objects, attributes, counts, and relations provide controllable supervision for compositional understanding, while the two verification rounds produce rewards that update the same backbone used at test time.
Experiments on Qwen3.5-2B, Qwen3.5-4B, and InternVL3-2B backbones show that PROVE improves fine-grained compositional understanding across multiple benchmarks. On the reference backbone, it also strengthens visual-detail sensitivity, with limited, benchmark-dependent changes on broader multimodal tasks.
These results suggest that self-play over perturbation, verification, and repair offers a practical alternative to static judge distillation for building stronger vision-language verifiers.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了PROVE,通过闭合的透视-验证-修复-验证循环,培训视觉语言验证员的自我游戏框架.
PROVE不依靠更强的外部判断,固定硬负数据集,或静态偏好说明,而是将普通的清洁图像封装对转换成适应性的验证事件.
单个共享的 MLLM 在不同角色下扮演一个 Mutator, 校验器, 和修复器的提示:  Mutator 创建本地化的图像文本不匹配, 校验器诊断它们, 修复器试图从视觉证据和校验器反馈中恢复忠实的字幕.
这种设计将核查变成一个可操作的自我改进问题,模型不仅学会判断图像文本的忠实性,而且学会揭露和纠正其自身精细的失败模式.
由此产生的培训信号是固定的、适应性的和核查指导的。
在物体、属性、计数和关系上打入的扰动为理解组成提供了可控的监督,而两轮核查则产生奖励,更新试验时使用的同一主干。
在Quen3.5-2B,Quen3.5-4B,以及InternVL3-2B骨干上的实验显示,PROVE改进了跨越多个基准的精细成份理解. 在参考支柱方面,它还加强了视觉-细节敏感性,对更广泛的多式联运任务进行了有限、依赖基准的变化。
这些结果表明,自我游戏超越扰动、核查和修理,为建立更强大的视觉语言核查器提供了替代静态法官蒸馏的实用办法。

blocks.en: A.3 Reward Design Discussion
blocks.zh: A.3 奖励设计讨论

blocks.en:
The verifier-guided rewards in PROVE are designed to couple two complementary goals: exposing verifier weaknesses and recovering faithful captions.
For the Mutator, the reward contains an exposure term, a hardness term, and an edit-cost penalty.
The exposure term encourages perturbations that the current verifier fails to reject, while the hardness term encourages perturbations that remain challenging after repair.
The cost term discourages overly wide edits. Actions rejected by the deterministic editor receive a fixed penalty instead of C M C_{M} (Appendix F ).
blocks.zh:
PROVE中的核查者指导奖励旨在实现两个相辅相成的目标:揭露核查者的弱点和恢复忠实的字幕。
对于"变种人",奖励内容包括曝光期,硬度期,编辑成本处罚.
接触一词鼓励扰动,认为目前的核查者未能拒绝,而硬性术语则鼓励扰动,在修理后仍然具有挑战性。
成本术语不利于过于广泛的编辑。 被定型编辑拒绝的行动会受到固定的处罚,而不是C M C_{M}(附录F).

blocks.en:
For the Repairer, the reward contains an acceptance term, a judgment-flip term, and a repair-cost penalty.
The acceptance term encourages repaired captions that the verifier judges faithful, while the judgment-flip term rewards a change in the verifier decision, 𝟙 [ y 1 ≠ y 2 ] \mathbb{1}[y_{1}\neq y_{2}] ; the separate acceptance term favors a faithful accepted repair.
The repair-cost penalty discourages unnecessary rewriting and encourages localized correction.

(x,p)\xrightarrow{\text{Mutator }}p^{\prime}\xrightarrow{\text{Verifier}}(y_{1},r_{1})\xrightarrow{\text{Repairer }}\tilde{p}\xrightarrow{\text{Verifier}}(y_{2},r_{2}).

为了补充第3节中的方法描述,我们提供了四种支持的 Mutator 扰动类型:计数、属性、关系和对象。
每一个例子都遵循了ururb - 校验 - 修补 - 校验轨迹:(x,p) – Mutator p - 校验器 (y 1,r 1) – 校验器 p - 校验器 (y 2, r 2). (x,p)\xrightarrow\xtext{校验器 }}p^{\p^{\p}\p}\xrightarrow\xtext{校验器 (y_{1},r_{1})\xrightarrow\text{ repairer (原始内容存档于2019-09-29). Tilde{p}\xrightarrow\text{校对}(y_{2},r_{2}).

blocks.en:
The Mutator emits a localized edit of the form ( edit_type , target_text , replacement ) (\texttt{edit\_type},\texttt{target\_text},\texttt{replacement}) , which is applied to the clean caption p p to obtain the perturbed caption p ′ p^{\prime} .
The Verifier first judges whether p ′ p^{\prime} matches the image and returns a binary decision y 1 y_{1} with textual feedback r 1 r_{1} .
Conditioned on the image, the perturbed caption, and this feedback, the Repairer directly generates a repaired caption p ~ \tilde{p} .
The Verifier is then invoked again to obtain ( y 2 , r 2 ) (y_{2},r_{2}) .
These examples illustrate how PROVE converts clean image-caption pairs into grounded hard negatives and repair targets without requiring a stronger external judge.
blocks.zh:
Mutator 发出窗体的本地化编辑( 编辑_ 类型, 目标_ 文本, 替换) (\ textt{edit{},\ text{ 目标}\ text{ text},\ textt{ 替换}) , 它被应用到干净的字幕 p 上, 以获取扰动的字幕 p > prime} 。
校验者首先判断p ' p^{\prime} 是否匹配图像并返回二进制决定 y 1 y_{1} 与文本反馈 r 1 r_{1} 。
在图像、扰动标题和反馈上,修复者直接生成一个已修复的标题 p~\tilde{p} 。
然后再次引用验证符来获取(y 2, r 2) (y_{2}, r_{2}).
这些例子说明了PROVE如何将干净的图像封装对转换成固定的硬底片和修复目标而不需要更强大的外部法官.

blocks.en: Across the four edit types, the same minimal-edit principle holds: the Mutator flips exactly one semantic slot ( count , attribute , relation , or object ) via a structured edit, the first Verifier pass localises the mismatch via a short rationale, and the Repairer uses that rationale to directly generate a faithful caption p ~ \tilde{p} that, modulo at most a few-token paraphrase (e.g. “standing indoors” → \to “indoors”), matches the original p p . The second Verifier pass closes the loop and produces the success signal y 2 y_{2} that drives the Repairer reward r R r_{R} (Eq. 12 ). Because perturbation is a discrete typed action while repair is free-form caption generation, the two roles are not symmetric: the Mutator is constrained to expose verifier blind spots along a known axis, whereas the Repairer must recover the full caption from visual evidence and verifier feedback, which is what makes repair an operational form of verification.

blocks.en: C.1 External Trajectory Audit
blocks.zh: C.1 外部轨道审计

blocks.en:
We audit a held-out trajectory set using labels produced outside the self-play loop.
These labels are never used for training, reward computation, mutation generation, validation, or checkpoint selection.
The initial Qwen3.5-2B model and PROVE use the same role prompts and deterministic editor.
Table 12 reports verifier accuracy on a fixed set and the quality of the generated trajectories.
blocks.zh:
我们用自玩圈外的标签来审计一个被搁置的轨迹
这些标签从未用于训练,奖励计算,突变生成,验证,或检查站选择.
最初的Quen3.5-2B模型和PROVE使用相同的角色提示和定型编辑器.
表12汇报了固定装置上的核查者准确性以及生成的轨迹的质量。

blocks.en:
A valid localized perturbation introduces a real image-caption mismatch confined to the intended edit.
A correct verifier judgment identifies whether the caption is faithful to the image.
A faithful minimal repair corrects the mismatch without introducing unsupported changes.
A fully valid trajectory requires all four stages to be correct: a real localized mismatch, a correct diagnosis, a faithful minimal repair, and a correct final judgment.
The fully valid rate increases by 23.4 23.4 points, while fixed-set verifier accuracy increases by 7.8 7.8 points.
These external measurements support improved visual correctness, while the shared-model setting still leaves possible self-verification bias (Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh:
有效的本地化扰动引入了仅局限于预定编辑的真实图像封装不匹配.
正确的校验判断可以识别标题是否忠实于图像.
忠实的最小修补可以纠正不匹配而不引入不支持的更改.
完全有效的轨迹要求所有四个阶段都正确:真正的局部错配,正确的诊断,忠实的最低限度修复,正确的最终判断.
完全有效率提高23.4 23.4分,而固定设置的校验精度提高7.8 7.8分.
这些外部测量支持改进视觉正确性,而共享模型设置仍然可能留下自我核查的偏差(第4.3节)。

blocks.en: C.2 External Benchmark Trajectory
blocks.zh: C.2 外部基准轨迹

blocks.en:
We evaluate checkpoints on fixed, externally labeled benchmarks that are excluded from training, self-play rewards, mutation generation, validation, and checkpoint selection.
Table 13 separates the internal self-play pass rate from externally measured benchmark performance.
The compositional average increases from 83.22 83.22 to 86.85 86.85 , while the broader average increases from 58.77 58.77 to 61.03 61.03 .
The broader trajectory is not monotonic: its step-600 value is below step 450, illustrating why internal agreement is not a substitute for independent evaluation.
Across the six reported checkpoints, Pearson correlations between pass rate and the compositional/broader averages are 0.9254 / 0.9022 0.9254/0.9022 .
These descriptive correlations summarize co-movement during training; they do not establish a causal relationship or a significance test.
Figure 5 plots the six reported measurements without adding intermediate observations.

我们评价检查站的固定和外部标注的基准,这些基准不包括在培训、自我游戏奖励、突变生成、验证和检查站选择中。

blocks.en: C.3 Repeated-Run Variability and Broader Capability
blocks.zh: C.3 重复运行的变异性和更大的能力

blocks.en:
We repeat Qwen3.5-2B training with three independent seeds.
Table 14 reports the mean and standard deviation across the three trained models.
These statistics measure training-run variability, not example-level uncertainty, confidence intervals, or statistical significance.
The reference-run results in Tables 1 and 2 and the checkpoint table in Appendix A.2 remain single-run measurements.

我们重复使用三个独立种子的Quen3.5-2B训练.
表14报告三个训练有素模型的平均偏差和标准偏差。
这些统计数据衡量的是培训-运行的变异性,而不是实例一级的不确定性、信心间隔或统计意义。
表1和表2中的参考运行结果和附录A.2中的检查站表仍然是单运行计量。

blocks.en:
The core compositional average improves by 3.51 3.51 points across seeds.
Broader changes are limited and task-dependent: ViVerBench regresses by 2.04 2.04 points, MMMU and MathVista decrease by 0.39 0.39 and 0.86 0.86 , MMBench improves by 0.95 0.95 , and POPE remains nearly unchanged.
Thus, PROVE substantially improves compositional verification without implying uniform preservation or improvement of all broader capabilities.

blocks.en:
We apply the same perturbation and reward formulation to Qwen3.5-4B and the scale-matched InternVL3-2B family.
Table 4 in the main paper reports the full base and PROVE averages for all three backbones.
The Qwen3.5-4B gains are 3.56 / 2.34 3.56/2.34 compositional/broader points, while InternVL3-2B gains 3.15 / 2.83 3.15/2.83 .
These results show that the gains extend beyond the 2B Qwen reference setting, although all runs still rely on one source training corpus.

blocks.en: D.2 Leave-One-Type-Out Transfer
blocks.zh: D.2 休假-一线外转移

blocks.en:
For each leave-one-type-out experiment, we remove the held-out type from the Mutator action space and resample the remaining types to preserve the same episode count and optimization budget.
Table 15 reports performance on the held-out axis.
The retained gain is ( s LOO − s base ) / ( s full − s base ) (s_{\mathrm{LOO}}-s_{\mathrm{base}})/(s_{\mathrm{full}}-s_{\mathrm{base}}) .
These axis-level scores follow the capability aggregation used in Figure 3 (b), rather than the overall averages in the main tables.
Leave-one-out training retains 48.2 % 48.2\% – 52.4 % 52.4\% of the full-method gain across the three reported axes.
This supports cross-type transfer while showing that direct exposure supplies additional axis-specific benefit.

对于每次留一型的实验,我们都会从Mutator动作空间中移除被搁置的类型,并重新模拟其余类型,以保留相同的插曲计数和优化预算.

blocks.en: D.3 Single- and Multi-Edit Curricula
blocks.zh: D.3 单一和多种教材

blocks.en:
Table 16 compares one-edit, mixed one/two-edit, and two-edit curricula.
The mixed curriculum raises the broader average by 0.15 0.15 points but lowers compositional performance and repair success.
Using two edits throughout further reduces repair success to 48.6 % 48.6\% .
These results support single localized edits as the default because they simplify diagnosis, minimal repair, and credit assignment.
A multi-edit extension may benefit from explicit partial-credit rewards, which are not evaluated in these comparisons.

表16比较了单版、双版和双版的课程。
混合课程将更广泛的平均数提高了0.15 0.15分,但降低了组成业绩和修复成功率。
在整个过程中使用两个编辑进一步将修复成功率降低到48.6% 48.6% 。
这些结果支持将单一本地化编辑作为默认,因为它们简化了诊断,最小修补,以及信用分配.

blocks.en: Appendix G Axis-level Gains, Qualitative Behavior, and Task Extensions
blocks.zh: 附录G 轴心级增益、定性行为和任务扩展

blocks.en: G.1 Axis-level Gains
blocks.zh: G.1 轴心级收益

blocks.en:
Axis-level gains. Figure 3 (b) summarizes where the gains of PROVE come from by aggregating benchmark splits according to the visual-semantic capability they test.
The largest improvements appear on attribute and relation verification, which are directly aligned with the typed perturbations used by the Mutator.
This pattern supports the intended training mechanism: localized perturbations create visually checkable mismatches, forcing the Verifier to diagnose fine-grained inconsistencies and the Repairer to recover faithful captions.
The positive gain on visual-detail sensitivity further suggests that verifier-guided repair improves localized evidence grounding beyond the core compositional benchmarks.
In contrast, object and color/order gains are smaller but still positive, partly because the base model already performs strongly on these axes.
blocks.zh:
轴级收益. 图3(b)汇总了PROVE收益的来源,根据它们测试的视觉语义能力汇总基准分数。
最大的改进出现在属性和关系验证上,它们与Mutator使用的打字扰动直接对齐.
这种模式支持了预定的培训机制:局部扰动产生可视性可校验的错配,迫使验证器诊断有细纹的不一致,而修复器则恢复忠实的字幕.
视觉-细节敏感性方面的积极进展进一步表明,核查器-制导的修复改进了超出核心构成基准的局部证据基础。
与此相反,物体和颜色/顺序增益较小,但仍然为正数,部分原因是基模型在这些轴上已经表现强劲。

blocks.en: G.2 Qualitative Behavior and Failure Cases
blocks.zh: G.2 定性行为和失败案件

blocks.en:
Qualitative verifier behavior. Figure 4 provides representative examples of how the learned verifier changes after self-play training.
The base model often accepts captions or answers that overlook a localized mismatch, such as an incorrect relation, missing object evidence, wrong attribute, or counting error.
After PROVE training, the verifier produces judgments that better track the relevant visual evidence and reject mismatches that the base model misses.
These examples indicate that PROVE does not merely improve aggregate scores; it changes the verifier’s behavior in the intended direction, making it more sensitive to the same visual-semantic factors targeted by the perturb–verify–repair loop.
blocks.zh:
定性修证行为. 图4提供了学习的核查人员在自我游戏培训后如何改变的代表性实例。
基础模型经常接受忽略局部错配的字幕或答案,如不正确关系,缺失对象证据,错误属性,或计数错误.
在PROVE培训后,核查员会做出判断,更好地跟踪相关视觉证据,并拒绝基础模型错过的错配.
这些例子表明,PROVE并不只是提高总分;它改变了核查者的行为向预定方向发展,使其更敏感地关注被扰动-核查-修复循环所瞄准的相同的视觉语义因素。

blocks.en:
Failure cases. Our error analysis identifies four recurring settings: small or occluded objects that are misperceived; ambiguous relations in crowded scenes or unusual viewpoints; overlapping instances or unclear counting conventions; and descriptions that require external knowledge and invite language-prior judgments rather than image-grounded verification.
These settings can affect mutation validity, verifier diagnosis, or repair quality.
A localized edit may fail to create an unambiguous mismatch, a Verifier may misidentify the relevant evidence, or a Repairer may alter additional unsupported details.
The independent audit evaluates these stages separately rather than treating final acceptance as sufficient evidence of a faithful trajectory.
blocks.zh:
失败案例。 我们的错误分析确定了四个反复出现的设置:小的或隐蔽的物体被误解;在拥挤的场景或异乎寻常的观点中关系模糊;事件重叠或计算不清的惯例;以及需要外部知识和邀请语言优先判断而不是基于图像的核查的描述。
这些设置可以影响突变的有效性,验证者诊断,或修复质量.
本地化编辑可能无法产生明确无误的不匹配,验证者可能错误识别相关证据,或者修补者可能改变额外的不支持的细节.
独立审计分别评价这些阶段,而不是将最后接受作为忠实轨迹的充分证据。

blocks.en:
Task extensions. The loop can be adapted when a task provides a known-correct multimodal instance and a structured operation that creates a verifiable error.
For VQA, the Mutator could alter an answer, rationale, or question condition and the Repairer could recover the visually supported answer.
For visual grounding, it could perturb a region, bounding box, or referring phrase; for referring expressions, it could alter target attributes or relations.
The present experiments establish caption-based verification and benchmark transfer, not task-specific self-play training for these extensions.
blocks.zh:
任务扩展 。 当一项任务提供了已知的正确多式联运实例和造成可核查错误的结构化操作时,循环可以被调整.
就VQA而言,Mutator可以改变一个答案、理由或问题条件,而修复者可以恢复视觉支持的答案。
对于视觉定位,它可以扰动一个区域,边框,或者引用短语;对于引用表达式,它可以改变目标属性或关系.
本实验建立了基于标题的核查和基准转移,而不是针对这些扩展的特定任务的自我游戏培训。

blocks.en: NeurIPS Paper Checklist
blocks.zh: 神经病 纸张核对表

blocks.en: 1. Claims Question: Do the main claims made in the abstract and introduction accurately reflect the paper’s contributions and scope? Answer: [Yes] Justification: The abstract and introduction state the main contribution of PROVE as a verifier-guided self-play framework for improving vision-language verifiers. The claims are supported by the method description, the main compositional understanding results, the broader benchmark results, and the limitations discussed in Section 4.3 . 2. Limitations Question: Does the paper discuss the limitations of the work performed by the authors? Answer: [Yes] Justification: Section 4.3 discusses the limitations of the current action space, difficulty saturation, general-VL regression at small scale, and the reliance on clean reference captions. 3. Theory assumptions and proofs Question: For each theoretical result, does the paper provide the full set of assumptions and a complete (and correct) proof? Answer: [N/A] Justification: The paper does not present theoretical results or formal theorems. The contribution is an empirical self-play training framework for vision-language verifiers. 4. Experimental result reproducibility Question: Does the paper fully disclose all the information needed to reproduce the main experimental results of the paper to the extent that it affects the main claims and/or conclusions of the paper (regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not)? Answer: [No] Justification: Sections 3 and 4 and Appendix A describe the method, data size, benchmarks, optimization settings, and reference compute. Appendix F gives the complete role prompts, output formats, reward weights, and cost definitions. Some supplemental audit/baseline settings are not supplied in the current materials; full reproduction requires these details and the planned code release. 5. Open access to data and code Question: Does the paper provide open access to the data and code, with sufficient instructions to faithfully reproduce the main experimental results, as described in supplemental material? Answer: [No] Justification: The training uses existing image-caption data and public benchmarks. The complete prompts are listed in Appendix F ; training and evaluation code and launch scripts are planned for release but are not included in the present supplement. 6. Experimental setting/details Question: Does the paper specify all the training and test details (e.g., data splits, hyperparameters, how they were chosen, type of optimizer) necessary to understand the results? Answer: [No] Justification: The backbone, data sizes, principal optimization settings, evaluation metrics, and matched comparisons are specified, and Appendix F gives the full prompt templates, reward weights, and cost definitions. Supplemental audit/baseline settings remain needed for complete reproduction. 7. Experiment statistical significance Question: Does the paper report error bars suitably and correctly defined or other appropriate information about the statistical significance of the experiments? Answer: [Yes] Justification: Appendix C.3 reports means and standard deviations across three independent Qwen3.5-2B training runs for the core compositional average and five broader benchmarks. These measure training-run variability, not confidence intervals or significance tests. 8. Experiments compute resources Question: For each experiment, does the paper provide sufficient information on the computer resources (type of compute workers, memory, time of execution) needed to reproduce the experiments? Answer: [Yes] Justification: Section 4 and Appendix A report that the main experiments use a single node with 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs, BF16 mixed precision, rollout size, batch size, and optimizer settings. Appendix A.4 reports wall-clock time, GPU-hours, and generated-token counts for the reference run and supervision baselines. 9. Code of ethics Question: Does the research conducted in the paper conform, in every respect, with the NeurIPS Code of Ethics https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ? Answer: [Yes] Justification: The work studies verifier training for image-text understanding using existing datasets, public benchmarks, and standard VLM training procedures. We are not aware of any aspect of the research that violates the NeurIPS Code of Ethics. 10. Broader impacts Question: Does the paper discuss both potential positive societal impacts and negative societal impacts of the work performed? Answer: [Yes] Justification: The paper discusses verifier training for detecting image-text mismatches and hallucinations, which can improve reliability of multimodal systems. Potential risks include over-reliance on imperfect verifiers or use of stronger verification models in automated filtering systems; these concerns are partly addressed through the limitations discussion. 11. Safeguards Question: Does the paper describe safeguards that have been put in place for responsible release of data or models that have a high risk for misuse (e.g., pre-trained language models, image generators, or scraped datasets)? Answer: [N/A] Justification: The paper does not introduce a new high-risk pretrained model, image generator, or scraped dataset. It trains a verifier using existing image-caption data and evaluates on public benchmarks; any released code will be for reproducing the training and evaluation pipeline. 12. Licenses for existing assets Question: Are the creators or original owners of assets (e.g., code, data, models), used in the paper, properly credited and are the license and terms of use explicitly mentioned and properly respected? Answer: [Yes] Justification: The paper cites the Qwen3.5 backbone, VeRL/HybridFlow framework, ShareGPT-4o-Image-style data, and all evaluation benchmarks used in the experiments. We will follow the licenses and terms of use of these existing assets when releasing code and reproduction instructions. 13. New assets Question: Are new assets introduced in the paper well documented and is the documentation provided alongside the assets? Answer: [No] Justification: The current supplement documents the training framework and experiments; the proposed training and evaluation code artifact and its complete reproduction documentation are not yet included. 14. Crowdsourcing and research with human subjects Question: For crowdsourcing experiments and research with human subjects, does the paper include the full text of instructions given to participants and screenshots, if applicable, as well as details about compensation (if any)? Answer: [N/A] Justification: The paper does not involve crowdsourcing experiments or research with human subjects. 15. Institutional review board (IRB) approvals or equivalent for research with human subjects Question: Does the paper describe potential risks incurred by study participants, whether such risks were disclosed to the subjects, and whether Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals (or an equivalent approval/review based on the requirements of your country or institution) were obtained? Answer: [N/A] Justification: The paper does not involve human subjects research, crowdsourcing, or user studies, so IRB approval is not applicable. 16. Declaration of LLM usage Question: Does the paper describe the usage of LLMs if it is an important, original, or non-standard component of the core methods in this research? Note that if the LLM is used only for writing, editing, or formatting purposes and does not impact the core methodology, scientific rigor, or originality of the research, declaration is not required. Answer: [Yes] Justification: The core method uses a multimodal LLM backbone as the Mutator, Verifier, and Repairer under different role prompts. This usage is central to the method and is described in Sections 3 and 4.

blocks.en: Answer: [N/A]

blocks.en: Justification: The paper does not present theoretical results or formal theorems. The contribution is an empirical self-play training framework for vision-language verifiers.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 论文没有提出理论结果或正式定理. 贡献是视觉语言验证员的经验性自演培训框架.

blocks.en: Experimental result reproducibility
blocks.zh: 实验结果可复制

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper fully disclose all the information needed to reproduce the main experimental results of the paper to the extent that it affects the main claims and/or conclusions of the paper (regardless of whether the code and data are provided or not)?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否充分披露复制文件主要实验结果所需的所有信息,以影响文件的主要主张和/或结论(无论是否提供代码和数据)?

blocks.en: Answer: [No]
blocks.zh: 答复:[无]

blocks.en: Justification: Sections 3 and 4 and Appendix A describe the method, data size, benchmarks, optimization settings, and reference compute. Appendix F gives the complete role prompts, output formats, reward weights, and cost definitions. Some supplemental audit/baseline settings are not supplied in the current materials; full reproduction requires these details and the planned code release.
blocks.zh: 理由说明:第3和第4节及附录 一个描述方法,数据大小,基准,优化设置,以及参考计算. 附 录 F给出了完整的角色提示,输出格式,奖励权重,以及成本定义. 一些补充审计/基准设置没有在目前材料中提供;完整复制需要这些细节和计划中的代码发布.

blocks.en: Open access to data and code
blocks.zh: 开放对数据和代码的访问

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper provide open access to the data and code, with sufficient instructions to faithfully reproduce the main experimental results, as described in supplemental material?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否提供了开放的数据和代码,并有足够的指示,如补充材料所述,忠实地复制主要的实验结果?

blocks.en: Answer: [No]
blocks.zh: 答复:[无]

blocks.en: Justification: The training uses existing image-caption data and public benchmarks. The complete prompts are listed in Appendix F ; training and evaluation code and launch scripts are planned for release but are not included in the present supplement.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 培训使用现有的图像封装数据和公共基准。 完整的提示在附录F中列出;培训和评价代码及发射脚本计划发布,但未列入本补编.

blocks.en: Experimental setting/details
blocks.zh: 实验设置/细节

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper specify all the training and test details (e.g., data splits, hyperparameters, how they were chosen, type of optimizer) necessary to understand the results?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否具体说明了解结果所需的所有培训和测试细节(如数据分割、超参数、如何选择、优化者的类型)?

blocks.en: Answer: [No]
blocks.zh: 答复:[无]

blocks.en: Justification: The backbone, data sizes, principal optimization settings, evaluation metrics, and matched comparisons are specified, and Appendix F gives the full prompt templates, reward weights, and cost definitions. Supplemental audit/baseline settings remain needed for complete reproduction.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 规定了主干、数据大小、主要优化设置、评价指标和匹配比较,附录F给出了完整的快速模板、奖励权重和成本定义。 全面复制仍需要补充审计/基线设置。

blocks.en: Experiment statistical significance
blocks.zh: 实验统计意义

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper report error bars suitably and correctly defined or other appropriate information about the statistical significance of the experiments?
blocks.zh: 问题: 纸质报告错误是否含有适当和正确定义的信息或关于实验统计意义的其他适当信息?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: Appendix C.3 reports means and standard deviations across three independent Qwen3.5-2B training runs for the core compositional average and five broader benchmarks. These measure training-run variability, not confidence intervals or significance tests.
blocks.zh: 理由:附录C.3报告是指为核心构成平均数和五个更广泛的基准而运行的三门独立的Quen3.5-2B培训的偏差和标准偏差。 这些衡量培训的可变性,而不是信任间隔或意义测试。

blocks.en: Experiments compute resources
blocks.zh: 计算资源

blocks.en: Question: For each experiment, does the paper provide sufficient information on the computer resources (type of compute workers, memory, time of execution) needed to reproduce the experiments?
blocks.zh: 问题: 对于每个实验,论文是否提供了复制实验所需的计算机资源(计算工人的类型,内存,执行时间)的充分信息?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: Section 4 and Appendix A report that the main experiments use a single node with 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs, BF16 mixed precision, rollout size, batch size, and optimizer settings. Appendix A.4 reports wall-clock time, GPU-hours, and generated-token counts for the reference run and supervision baselines.
blocks.zh: 理由说明:第4节和附录 一份报告称,主要实验使用一个单节点,有8个NVIDIA A100 GPU,BF16混合精度,推出大小,批量大小,以及优化器设置. 附录A.4报告了墙点时间、GPU小时以及参考运行和监督基线的生成计数。

blocks.en: Code of ethics
blocks.zh: 道德守则

blocks.en: Question: Does the research conducted in the paper conform, in every respect, with the NeurIPS Code of Ethics https://neurips.cc/public/EthicsGuidelines ?
blocks.zh: 问题: 本文所进行的研究是否在各个方面都符合《新教IPS道德守则》(https://neurips.cc/public/Ethics Guidelines)?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: The work studies verifier training for image-text understanding using existing datasets, public benchmarks, and standard VLM training procedures. We are not aware of any aspect of the research that violates the NeurIPS Code of Ethics.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 利用现有数据集、公共基准和标准VLM培训程序进行图像文本理解的工作研究核查培训。 我们不知道研究有任何方面违反《新IPS道德守则》。

blocks.en: Broader impacts
blocks.zh: 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper discuss both potential positive societal impacts and negative societal impacts of the work performed?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否讨论了所开展工作的潜在积极社会影响和消极社会影响?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: The paper discusses verifier training for detecting image-text mismatches and hallucinations, which can improve reliability of multimodal systems. Potential risks include over-reliance on imperfect verifiers or use of stronger verification models in automated filtering systems; these concerns are partly addressed through the limitations discussion.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 论文讨论了检测图像文本不匹配和幻觉的核查者培训,这可以提高多式联运系统的可靠性。 潜在风险包括过度依赖不完善的核查员或在自动过滤系统中使用更强大的核查模式;这些关切通过限制讨论得到部分解决。

blocks.en: Safeguards
blocks.zh: 保障措施

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper describe safeguards that have been put in place for responsible release of data or models that have a high risk for misuse (e.g., pre-trained language models, image generators, or scraped datasets)?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否描述了为负责任地发布具有高度滥用风险的数据或模型(例如,经过预先培训的语言模型、图像生成器或报废数据集)而实施的保障措施?

blocks.en: Answer: [N/A]
blocks.zh: 答复:[不详]

blocks.en: Justification: The paper does not introduce a new high-risk pretrained model, image generator, or scraped dataset. It trains a verifier using existing image-caption data and evaluates on public benchmarks; any released code will be for reproducing the training and evaluation pipeline.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 论文没有引入新的高风险预先训练模型,图像生成器,或被刮掉的数据集. 它利用现有图像封装数据培训一个核查员,并根据公共基准进行评估;任何发布的代码都将用于复制培训和评价管道。

blocks.en: Licenses for existing assets
blocks.zh: 现有资产的许可证

blocks.en: Question: Are the creators or original owners of assets (e.g., code, data, models), used in the paper, properly credited and are the license and terms of use explicitly mentioned and properly respected?
blocks.zh: 问题: 纸上是否使用资产(例如代码、数据、模型)的创造者或原始所有人,是否适当贷记,许可证和使用条款是否明确提及和适当遵守?

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: The paper cites the Qwen3.5 backbone, VeRL/HybridFlow framework, ShareGPT-4o-Image-style data, and all evaluation benchmarks used in the experiments. We will follow the licenses and terms of use of these existing assets when releasing code and reproduction instructions.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 论文引用了Quen3.5主干线,VERL/HybridFlow框架,ShareGPT-4o-Image风格的数据,以及实验中使用的所有评价基准. 在发布代码和复制指令时,我们将遵守这些现有资产的许可证和使用条件。

blocks.en: New assets
blocks.zh: 新资产

blocks.en: Question: Are new assets introduced in the paper well documented and is the documentation provided alongside the assets?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件中介绍的新资产是否有详细记录,是否与资产一起提供文件?

blocks.en: Answer: [No]
blocks.zh: 答复:[无]

blocks.en: Justification: The current supplement documents the training framework and experiments; the proposed training and evaluation code artifact and its complete reproduction documentation are not yet included.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 目前的补编记录了培训框架和试验;拟议的培训和评价密码文物及其完整的复制文件尚未列入。

blocks.en: Crowdsourcing and research with human subjects
blocks.zh: 与人类学科的众包和研究

blocks.en: Question: For crowdsourcing experiments and research with human subjects, does the paper include the full text of instructions given to participants and screenshots, if applicable, as well as details about compensation (if any)?
blocks.zh: 问题: 关于众包实验和与人类主体的研究,论文是否包括提供给参与者的指示全文和(如果适用的话)截图,以及(如果有)补偿的细节?

blocks.en: Answer: [N/A]
blocks.zh: 答复:[不详]

blocks.en: Justification: The paper does not involve crowdsourcing experiments or research with human subjects.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 论文不涉及与人类主体的众包实验或研究.

blocks.en: Institutional review board (IRB) approvals or equivalent for research with human subjects
blocks.zh: 机构审查委员会(IRB)批准或相当于与人有关的研究

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper describe potential risks incurred by study participants, whether such risks were disclosed to the subjects, and whether Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals (or an equivalent approval/review based on the requirements of your country or institution) were obtained?
blocks.zh: 问题: 文件是否描述了研究参与者可能面临的风险,是否向主体披露了这些风险,以及是否获得了机构审查委员会的批准(或根据贵国或机构的要求获得同等的批准/审查)?

blocks.en: Answer: [N/A]
blocks.zh: 答复:[不详]

blocks.en: Justification: The paper does not involve human subjects research, crowdsourcing, or user studies, so IRB approval is not applicable.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 论文不涉及人类课题研究,众包,或用户研究,因此IRB批准不适用.

blocks.en: Declaration of LLM usage
blocks.zh: 声明LLM的使用

blocks.en: Question: Does the paper describe the usage of LLMs if it is an important, original, or non-standard component of the core methods in this research? Note that if the LLM is used only for writing, editing, or formatting purposes and does not impact the core methodology, scientific rigor, or originality of the research, declaration is not required.
blocks.zh: 问题: 论文是否描述了LLMs的使用,如果它是本研究核心方法的重要、原始或非标准组成部分? 请注意,如果LLM只用于写作,编辑或格式化目的,且不影响研究的核心方法,科学严谨性或独创性,则不需要声明.

blocks.en: Answer: [Yes]
blocks.zh: 答复:[是]

blocks.en: Justification: The core method uses a multimodal LLM backbone as the Mutator, Verifier, and Repairer under different role prompts. This usage is central to the method and is described in Sections 3 and 4.
blocks.zh: 理由说明: 核心方法使用多式联运LLM主干线作为不同角色提示下的Mutator,Vivier,以及修理机. 这种使用是方法的核心,第3和第4节对此作了说明。
